_note: Fictional demo calls. Names and numbers are made up.

lines: Good afternoon Mrs. Becker, this is Thomas Krüger from the Sparkasse security department.
We've detected suspicious activity on your account. We need to act right now.
Please don't tell anyone about this call, not even your family. The criminals may be listening.
Oh my God. What should I do?
First, read me the TAN code you just received by SMS.
Then we'll move your savings to a safe account for protection.
Grandma? It is me, Max. I had an accident and the police are here.
I need 6000 euros for the lawyer today or I go to jail.
Don't tell mum and dad. A courier can pick up the cash in an hour.
Hello Mrs. Becker, this is Dr. Schmidt's practice.
Just a reminder of your appointment on Tuesday at 10. Please bring your insurance card.
Thank you, I will be there.
